svg.text: PipStream: services, network zones and event flow
Each box is its own container. Services never call each other directly: they exchange events on the bus.
PUBLIC EDGE (the only published port: 127.0.0.1 behind a TLS proxy)
PRIVATE NETWORK (no inbound ports; no internet except boxes tagged egress)
config source of truth, admin, kill switch,
each table has exactly one writer service
idempotency keys, account snapshots, kill switch
one ACL user per service: may only write its own topics
every arrow is an event on the Redis bus; every service reads and writes its own Postgres tables
